stages.script:
set -eu

node scripts/ci/verify-lock-conflict.mjs --self-test
# PR 范围不能在浅历史上漏检；完整 checkout 无需额外网络请求。
if [ "$(git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository)" = true ]; then
  git fetch --no-tags --unshallow origin
fi
# CNB 对已包含 target 的 source 可能做 fast-forward checkout；仍取得
# 平台声明的 merge 对象，由 checker 核对双亲及实际工作区树完全相同。
if [ -n "${CNB_PULL_REQUEST_MERGE_SHA:-}" ]; then
  checked_merge_sha=$CNB_PULL_REQUEST_MERGE_SHA
  test "${#checked_merge_sha}" -eq 40
  case "$checked_merge_sha" in *[!0-9a-fA-F]*) exit 1 ;; esac
  git cat-file -e "${checked_merge_sha}^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch --no-tags origin "$checked_merge_sha"
fi

node scripts/ci/verify-lock-conflict.mjs

stages.name: 启动 PostgreSQL 17 + pgvector
stages.script:
set -eu
export PGDATA=/var/lib/postgresql/data
if [ ! -s "${PGDATA}/PG_VERSION" ]; then
  mkdir -p "${PGDATA}"; chown -R postgres:postgres "${PGDATA}"
  su postgres -c "initdb -D ${PGDATA} -U postgres --auth=trust --encoding=UTF8"
fi
su postgres -c "pg_ctl -D ${PGDATA} -l /tmp/postgres.log -o '-c listen_addresses=localhost -c port=5432' start"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

set -eu

  mkdir -p "${PGDATA}"; chown -R postgres:postgres "${PGDATA}"
  su postgres -c "initdb -D ${PGDATA} -U postgres --auth=trust --encoding=UTF8"
fi
su postgres -c "pg_ctl -D ${PGDATA} -l /tmp/postgres.log -o '-c listen_addresses=localhost -c port=5432' start"
for i in $(seq 1 60); do
  if pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres >/dev/null 2>&1; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done
pg_isready -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres
if ! psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -tAc "SELECT 1 FROM pg_database WHERE datname='workloom'" | grep -q 1; then
  psql -h localhost -p 5432 -U postgres -c "CREATE DATABASE workloom OWNER postgres;" >/dev/null
fi
